prompt: In the cinematic film still style, a misty village market awakens under pale dawn light. On the left, an old woman in a blue shawl sits on a low wooden stool, her posture slumped with fatigue. Beside her, a woven basket of bright oranges rests on the cobblestones, its wicker texture rough and weathered. In the center, a young boy in a striped shirt points eagerly at a hanging lantern, his finger extended toward the flickering flame. The lantern sways gently above a stack of clay pots, which are arranged neatly on a table covered in burlap. To the right, a baker in a white apron hands a steaming loaf to a customer in a green coat, their hands meeting in a brief exchange of warmth. Next to the customer, a black cat watches intently, its eyes wide and reflective in the dim light. Behind them, a tall man in a brown hat looks at a map spread across a crate, his brow furrowed in concentration. A brown dog lies near the crate, its head resting on its paws, sleeping soundly amidst the early morning hustle. Further back, a vendor in a yellow tunic arranges bundles of herbs, his movements precise and deliberate. Finally, a child in a red dress stands near the edge of the frame, holding a single flower tightly in her small hand. There is no modern signage visible anywhere in the scene. There is no electronic equipment present among the stalls.
